hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler vaults. In beforeSwap, it handles all token flow directly—depositing input tokens into an Euler vault and withdrawing output tokens from another—returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard Uniswap v4 pool math. Standard LP positions and donations are blocked; liquidity is provided exclusively through Euler vault deposits.
